title: Quote Reflects Real Route
description: Change both the route and the package across two full back-and-forth cycles through the wizard, and confirm the quote on screen tracks reality the whole way — never showing a distance or price left over from an earlier combination.
successCondition: Starting from a short domestic route and a light package, a test records the initial Pricing step's distanceKm and priceCents; goes back to change the destination to a distant international hub, advances again, and confirms distanceKm increases substantially and priceCents changes accordingly; goes back again to also increase the package weight significantly, advances, and confirms priceCents increases further from the previous value — three distinct quote snapshots in total, each strictly consistent with the inputs active at the time it was fetched.
hints: Record the exact numeric values at each of the three checkpoints rather than just confirming "the page looks different" — this challenge is about correctness of the specific numbers, not just visible change.
The pricing formula (base + weight fee + distance fee) is documented in docs/api/booking.md if you want to sanity-check the direction each change should move the total.
